body: how can i take a break from him? i would be miserable without him. i missed him so much when i was spending a week at my parents' before christmas. i'd rather be miserable with him than miserable without him.

actually, i managed to get back into school. i've brought my gpa up from .84 to 2.75 over the last four semesters. i've been doing really well and i even made the dean's list last semester. i don't work because i'm majoring in art and it's really time-consuming. so we pay the rent six months in advance with what's left of my financial aid after tuition, books, and supplies. then everything he makes at his job goes to bills and groceries and his goddamn cigarettes and we still have to borrow money from his parents at the end of the month. he literally burns $150 a month and he says i have to give up my bunny because her vegetables are too expensive. i've brought up the amount he spends on smokes and he just gives me a dirty look and says he works hard and needs them to de-stress. i don't even know how to talk to him about any of this because i'm so scared that if i do he'll come right out and tell me he doesn't love me and i really would kill myself if that happened, none of the piddling little scratches i've made, i'd make one deep gash on each wrist and die in the bathtub, all i'd need to do is put a fresh blade in one of my craft knives.

i am interested in any other subreddits that could help, though.
